summary: Wide kerb where cars park, homes 16 m or more away.

best_section.where: Castile Street west kerb, about 40 m up from the main road junction

drivers.seclusion: Large detached homes 16 m or more away on the west side and across the road; no bush backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street wide enough for kerbside parking; parked cars are visible near 50 m.
drivers.convention: Residents park along this kerb; a van would blend in but not unnoticed overnight.

flags: Dwellings 16-23 m away on both sides
Rest of the stretch has houses 3-8 m from the kerb and slopes up to 12.6%
Sandy Creek 197 m away; low ground at the far end
Mapped gates 234 m or more away have ways round
sun_shade: Mostly open; a tree canopy sits on the east side near the start, giving afternoon shade.
